issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds a 'nhưng' (but) which implies a contrast or a sequence that is not present in the Greek. The Greek structure 'ει δε ου... φονευσεις' is a conditional construction ('if you do not [do X], you will [do Y]'). The Vietnamese 'nếu ngươi không phạm tội tà dâm, nhưng phạm tội giết người' makes it sound like two separate conditions/actions joined by 'but', whereas the Greek expresses a direct logical consequence of failing one condition and doing the other.
